meta.title: Nautical Festivals MX
meta.description: Festivales Náuticos Mx, an organization based in Los Cabos, Mexico, that organizes various nautical events such as the Nautical Day of the Dead Parade and the Christmas Nautical Festival "Mar y Christmas".

banner.headline: Experience the magic of the sea and Mexican tradition at Festivales Náuticos MX.

about.paragraph: Our festivals blend the majesty of the sea with the cultural richness of Mexico, creating unforgettable experiences for locals and visitors alike.

altares.title: Altars at Sea 2025
altares.info: “Altares en el Mar” is an immersive festival that honors our loved ones with floating offerings full of light and color.
altares.cta: Relive the most spectacular moments from last edition.

marxmas.title: Mar & Xmas 2025
marxmas.info: “Mar & Xmas” celebrates the holiday season with illuminated parades and activities for the whole family.
marxmas.cta: Discover how we live Christmas at sea.

tourism.text: Los Cabos is an unmatched destination where the desert meets the sea, offering activities for every taste.

sponsorship.heading: Join as a sponsor
sponsorship.info: Be part of a festival that connects brands with thousands of attendees and visitors.

gallery.heading: Past events gallery
gallery.text: See how we have transformed the sea into a stage of traditions.

footer.slogan: Festivales Náuticos MX – A sea of traditions
